Conduct research at one of the top 10 research-intensive universities in Canada or elevate your engineering or computer science career with a graduate degree, microprogram, or diploma.
Make your future at uOttawa engineering
The Faculty of Engineering offers a vibrant research environment where the traditional disciplines of mechanical, civil, chemical, electrical, computer, and software engineering and computer science come together in a unique synergy.
With over 20 graduate programs to choose from, you are sure to find one that fits your goals. Your program could allow you to:
Build skills for your career through professional development or CO-OP opportunities;
Pursue a research interest with support from one of our world-class professors;
Start your own business during your studies and benefit from our vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem.

International experience
Add an international component to your degree.
Indigenous and Black Engineering and Technology Momentum Fellowship (IBET)
This fellowship aims to support Indigenous and Black researchers in order to foster inclusion within academia at the University of Ottawa. If you aspire to becoming a leader in engineering research and education, and to being a role model for younger generations, this fellowship is for you.
Become an IBET Fellow

Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
#1 Most technology-intensive city in Canada
#1 Highest concentration of scientists and engineers in Canada, and #2 in North America after Silicon Valley
The region is recognized for excellence in research and innovation, according to Invest Ottawa and the Trade Commissioner Service
1,700+ knowledge-based companies with 68,000+ employees
44+ national and academic research labs
90% of Canada’s industrial telecommunications research and development is conducted in Ottawa
Over $4.7 billion invested in Ottawa technology companies in the last ten years
